description: This Java class 'ReportLine' encapsulates a data structure used for recording a report line with timestamp, MafValue, RpmValue, and wave information. It includes constructor, getters, and a toString method.

classes.name: ReportLine
classes.description: A class representing a report data entry with time, MafValue, RpmValue, and wave properties.

methods.name: ReportLine
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields of the report line.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp associated with this report line.

methods.name: getMaf
methods.description: Returns the MafValue object for this report line.

methods.name: getRpm
methods.description: Returns the RpmValue object for this report line.

methods.name: getWave
methods.description: Returns the wave value for this report line.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this report line.
